text.text_excerpt: Fun bar with a pool table. Staff are friendly and fun, great place to grab a beer. Definitely on the higher end of a Dive Bar. PBR on tap for $2.50 if you fancy a few cheap warm up beers or a decent selection of bourbons. Fantastic little spot. Even supplied us with bottles of water as we wobbled out. Thanks for having us.

Date of Visit: Tuesday April 18th Husband and I were in town on vacation. We visited many places over our five days in town. This bar was nothing fancy and actually quiet for being in the quarter. The customers all seemed to be locals. Hands down this place had one of the friendliest bartenders we met on our entire trip. I believe her name was Kathryn (sorry if I am wrong it was a late night!). She was super down to earth. Quick with our orders. Made suggestions on places to visit while in town. This was so refreshing after experiencing the worst bartenders in my entire life the night before at 30/90 on Frenchman (see my yelp review for details - seriously awful). While wandering around the area, we happened to stumble upon this quaint little bar. It wasn't too late, but we were the only people in the place. That was fine by me- there were some extra credits on the jukebox so I requested a few songs and we sat and had a few drinks. The feel of the place is divey and laid back and the bartender was super nice and friendly. I'm normally not a fan of places with internet jukeboxes, but it worked well here, maybe because it was only my songs playing. Ha. We weren't here long, but it was an enjoyable evening and I would come back for another visit.
